title: EE-106: Naive is the symbolic system and runs agents
body: Records Torian's 2026-11-02 decisions on what Naive is and how it runs agents. One new entry, EE-106, status in force, appended to `docs/decisions/decisions.json`. It builds on EE-105 (draft pull request 161). No code change. No docs change: the decision log is the record of this decision, and this pull request does not change behavior the docs describe. Checked against `framework` at `cb502f9`. The conflicts are listed in the entry and are not resolved here. 1. EE-098 and EE-041, plus `schema/check-boundary.mjs` and `interface/harness/run.mjs`: Naive is driven by outside agents, and the framework names no vendor. Decisions 5 and 15 run agents on Vercel. 2. Records are JSON files (`schema/data-model.json`). There is no statement type. `schema/raw-source.schema.json` stores source text in the venture. 3. `knowledge/connectors/filesystem.mjs` replaces the file on write. `schema/check-provenance.mjs` fails if a log line is removed. No redaction path. 4. Instructions are the live AGENTS.md chain (`interface/router.mjs`, EE-073), not a versioned agent configuration. 5. 106 of 128 record types have no decision class, so an agent write can be the record (`interface/router.mjs`, `packages/customers/skill/SKILL.md`). MCP and the HTTP API always write as an agent. 6. `interface/cli/mentura.mjs` accept records the actor as a person even when an agent runs it. 7. `schema/gate.mjs`, `schema/access.mjs` and `schema/visibility.mjs` are separate checks. A role with no routes may read every route. `interface/acting.mjs` refuses an agent in a person's role. 8. `schema/judgment.schema.json` links a judgment to an item path, not a statement. 9. The store is the venture folder (`knowledge/connectors/filesystem.mjs`, EE-086), not one Postgres database with an RDF export. EE-105's one-database decision is not on framework. 10. `schema/port-venture.mjs` moves code into `codebase/`. `platform/connectors/github.mjs` writes file contents by pull request. 11. GitHub knowledge writes are branch and merge (EE-037, `platform/connectors/github.mjs`). 12. EE-030 has three interfaces and no primary. 13. `schema/triggers.mjs` already fires on record changes. 14. Claude Code and Cursor are the in-use harnesses. `interface/harness/run.mjs` passes the process environment into `claude`. 15. `interface/adapters.mjs` runs Naive on a harness. Decision 25's adapter wraps the runtime. 16. Work is a handoff (EE-038, `schema/handoff.schema.json`). No task or chat-history record. 17. `docs/ontology.json` is the one noun list (EE-014). No per-organization SKOS scheme.
